subject: World Cup 2026 — read it with data, not noise
preview_text: Your matchday home for honest analysis — and a track record you can verify.
body_paragraphs: The biggest tournament on earth deserves better than guesswork.

That's why we built Predictify: AI that runs 24/7, expected goals, form, injuries, and real probabilities on 1X2, over/under, BTTS and more. On our highest-confidence picks, the model has been correct more than 80% of the time — and we publish every result so you can verify it yourself.
We created the World Cup 2026 hub inside the app for exactly this moment — pre-kickoff breakdowns, matchday threads, and honest recaps after full time.
Open the hub and drop your boldest call: dark horse, group-stage upset, or who lifts the trophy.
P.S. We're not a bookmaker and we don't promise guaranteed wins. We promise clear forecasts and a track record you can check — match by match.
